thesis: Every quality gate passes — zero pledge, unmodified audits, CFO 2.5x PAT, 60-day receivables — and FY26 was a genuine inflection: revenue +59%, PAT doubled on commissioned capacity, the BESS pivot earning real merchant revenue. But at Rs 433 the market prices 52x earnings and 6x book on a 3.75x-levered balance sheet with 1.6x interest cover, and the engine cannot anchor it: the frozen bare-schema DCF prints -Rs 419/share because it assumes 15% OPM against 28% dep/sales while the real IPP margin is ~88% (schema artifact, LEMON TREE precedent — not a short signal). The growth is real; the price already knows; leverage is the risk. WATCH for deleveraging receipts and execution on the 5 GW + 10 GWh build-out.
